name: claude-terminal-mods
description: Mods for the Claude Code terminal that draw one layout file, ~/.claude/terminal-layout.json, made in a drag-and-drop editor

plugins.name: checklist
plugins.description: A task checklist pane beside the chat, with a board of every session on this Mac and this session's subagents. Draws the sidebar and bandAbovePrompt blocks of ~/.claude/terminal-layout.json

plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Git guard for shared worktrees, a summary line under each answer drawn from the turnSummary lines of ~/.claude/terminal-layout.json, folded passing test output, macOS alerts when the session needs you or its work is done, and /mods-usage
